question: Find NSCLC trials with median follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, PubMed ID, overall follow-up duration, treatment arm follow-up duration, and control arm follow-up duration for all NSCLC trials in the database.
gemini.raw:
```json

  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%NSCLC%'",
```
